Dragon Master Silk.name: Dragon Master Silk
Dragon Master Silk.summary:
A less racy remake of the original Dragon Master Silk for the Sega Saturn.
The size of the dungeons are considerably wider than the original, and the erotic contents are slightly modified for Sega Saturn.

Kidou Senshi Z Gundam - Zenpen Zeta no K.name: Mobile Suit Z Gundam: Zenpen Zeta no Kodou
Kidou Senshi Z Gundam - Zenpen Zeta no K.summary: The First part of the 2D side-scrolling action game based on the Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam TV Show.

Tower, The.name: SimTower
Tower, The.summary: Welcome to the building simulation game SimTower, which offers the chance to build and manage all the complex, interconnected operations of a modern skycraper. You build your empire from nothing and become the engineer and general manager of your structure. You can provide offices, coffee shops or apartments to anyone who is willing to pay.
